Good Tuner, Could be Even Better!. This tuner is just the best in terms of layout and simplicity. But what’s holding it back are two things:
1) There is no option to create custom tunings. This is a very easy feature to implement since the tuner already has all the chromatic notes available, just let the user decide how many strings they want the metaphorical instrument to have and then let the user pick the note / Hz of those strings
2) This app needs a better way to store or save favorite tunings instead of a single scroll list with no good way to jump to what you want. Maybe just a search bar would solve this?

Perfect + what would make this app better. Through my years (3 years) of playing guitar and mandolin I’ve struggled to find a perfect tuner, most of the ones I’ve used aren’t spot on to the note, can’t pick up sound, and have a terrible design. But fine tuner has a simple design with no complexity, and is able to pick up your instrument over others playing around you. And after a year of using this tuner, I think it’s safe to say that this is the tuning perfect tuning app. 
One thing that I would love to see, is the l
“favorite” feature where you favorite your tuning so that way you can easily get to it instead of surfing through all the others. I often switch from open g, to standard, to dadgad, and many others and often find it time consuming to find the tuning I’m looking for. Although it’s not a puzzle to get to your tuning, it would be easier with the favorite feature.
